subject: Stakeholder mapping & buy-process exception for Redwood trial - next steps
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@enterprisecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>; Tom Huang <tom.huang@enterprisecorp.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + discovery - Redwood pilot follow-up

Thanks again for the demo this morning \u001F appreciate the concise walkthrough. A quick recap from our side and items we need to move forward: 

- Key decision criteria: predictable latency under P50 120ms for interactive agents, cost per 1M tokens, and reliability (SLO/SLA).
- Stakeholders: Samantha Lee (AI Platform lead, primary technical sponsor), Tom Huang (Procurement, handles PO and contract terms), Natalie Park (Legal, will review security addendum), Ben Carter (CFO/economic buyer, final sign-off on pricing).
- Procurement steps: Tom says typical timeline is 4-6 weeks after final SOW + PO; they prefer 45-day invoice terms but procurement sometimes insists on 30. Legal will need SOC 2 + data residency language.

Two asks for Redwood:
1) Can you share an initial EA/terms draft and a stakeholder map we can include in our internal brief?
2) Are you able to accept 45-day payment terms and a pilot SLA of 99.5% (we may request 99.9% later)?

Attaching a stakeholder map we compiled on our side. We'll circulate internally and come back with any additional names.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Director, AI Platform
EnterpriseCorp

Samantha \u001F great to meet you and team. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Recap: Pilot scope \u001F 3 model endpoints, up to 100k tokens/day, pilot term 30 days. Decision hinges on latency, reliability, and security posture (SOC 2 + data residency).
- We can share an EA/terms draft and a mutual action plan for the procurement timeline. Draft attached.
- Regarding terms: we typically accept 45-day invoicing for established enterprise customers, but custom SLA or extended calendar credits are handled as an exception and need internal approval (aditya_rao included).

Next steps:
1) I will send the EA/terms draft (attached) and a concise MLP that maps milestones to procurement deliverables.
2) Rishi will follow up with a short security/residency note and performance profile for the endpoint.
3) If you need a pricing exception or SLA below our standard 99.9% for this pilot, we'll raise an internal approval request and get back within 48 business hours.

Date: 2026-06-16T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Intro + discovery - Redwood pilot follow-up (security/residency notes)

Marissa / team \u001F following up with the technical items Samantha flagged. Short notes to include in the internal approval packet: 

- Data residency: we can isolate pilot traffic to us-west-2 and sign a simple data residency addendum (no cross-region backups). Will require config work and a small ops runbook.
- SLA request: standard platform SLA is 99.9%. For pilot we can offer 99.5% as an exception if legal signs off and finance accepts a pilot discount.
- Security artifacts: SOC 2 Type II report, pen-test summary, and a short architecture diagram. I can drop these into a secure share.

If we need to approve a pricing concession >15% or accept 45-day invoicing on a new customer, we'll need leadership/legal sign-off (cc-ing dev for contracts). Suggest we ask Aditya for an exception approval and specify the exact concession range and duration.

- Rishi
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-17T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Intro + discovery - Redwood pilot follow-up (legal considerations)

Marissa \u001F I reviewed the EA-terms draft and Rishi's notes. Key points: 

1) Payment terms: 30 days is ideal; 45 days is acceptable for pilot deals if accompanied by an order confirmation or a limited-time invoice schedule. If Finance (Ben) requires 45 days permanently, we should treat that as a commercial concession and limit the concession to the pilot term.
2) SLA: reducing SLA to 99.5% is a negotiable concession for a short pilot (30-90 days). For anything longer or material revenue impact we must require VP approval (Aditya) and include liquidated damage caps.
3) Security/data residency: SOC 2 + addendum acceptable; require security review sign-off and a statement in the SOW about where logs and backups reside.

If you need me to approve the EA redlines I can do so for the pilot-level concessions: up to 15% discount and 45-day invoicing for a single pilot term. Any discount beyond 15% or permanent SLA change requires Aditya's sign-off. Please confirm the exact asks (discount %, SLA target, invoice terms) and I will prepare redlines and a DocuSign envelope.

\u0014 Dev
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T16:47:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Intro + discovery - Redwood pilot follow-up (approval)

Thanks for the thread and clear ask. Approvals:

- Commercial concession: approve up to 15% one-time pilot discount (30-day pilot). Any request >15% must be escalated to me with expected ACV impact and payback.
- Invoicing: approve 45-day invoicing for pilot deals only; require order confirmation that ties scope to pilot dates.
- SLA: approve 99.5% for the 30-day pilot only. Permanent SLA reductions are not approved without a formal business case.
- Security: require SOC 2 Type II and a signed data residency addendum before pilot goes live. Rishi to provide artifacts; Security to sign off.

Marissa \u001F please: 1) confirm the exact discount percentage you intend to offer (<=15%), 2) get Procurement to confirm 45-day invoice acceptance for pilot, 3) send me the ACV projection for full production if they convert. Once confirmed, Dev please prepare redlines and DocuSign.

I'll also ask Finance (Ben) to brief if there's any blocker on the 45-day term.

Aditya Rao
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
